reviews.author: SOma Wisi
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, the gym is completely closed on Sundays and only operates for half a day on Fridays, which is very inconvenient for many members.

The main reason I’m leaving this review is the manager’s lack of responsibility toward members’ concerns and suggestions. Despite repeated attempts to communicate, the manager does not answer phone calls or respond to WhatsApp messages, leaving customers’ feedback and requests completely ignored.

We kindly ask the owners and those responsible to look into this matter and take members’ concerns seriously. Better communication and more suitable operating hours would greatly improve the overall experience.

reviews.author: Evance Juma
reviews.text: Jenoub Fitness Ajman is an excellent gym with great facilities, clean environment, and a very welcoming atmosphere. The staff are friendly, supportive, and highly professional — even the cleaning team keeps everything spotless, making workouts enjoyable. Truly one of the best gyms in Ajman

reviews.author: Sanjay Krishnan Mr
reviews.text: Yogesh is an excellent gym trainer with great knowledge, dedication, and a very supportive attitude. He always motivates and guides properly, making workouts effective and enjoyable. His commitment towards clients and attention to proper training really stand out. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Rabia Gilani
reviews.text: Amazing experience and love the group classes they are fun and effective! The trainer is amazing and friendly but highly committed to the workouts! Highly recommend this gym!

reviews.author: ABBAS PAZHAMKULATHINGAL
reviews.text:
I recently had the opportunity to visit Jenoub Fitness Ajman. Here's my comprehensive review of my experience.

*Facilities and Equipment:*
The gym has a wide range of modern equipment, including cardio machines, free weights, and resistance machines. The facilities are well-organized, making it easy to navigate.

*Cleanliness and Maintenance:*
The gym is spotless, and the equipment is regularly cleaned and maintained. I was impressed with the hygiene standards.

*Staff and Trainers:*
The staff are friendly and always ready to help. The trainers are knowledgeable and provided excellent guidance during my workout.

*Atmosphere and Ambience:*
The atmosphere is motivating, with upbeat music and good lighting. It's a pleasant place to work out.

*Membership and Fees:*
The membership fees are reasonable, especially considering the quality of the facilities. They also offer various promotions throughout the year.

*Location and Accessibility:*
Located in a convenient area, it's easy to get to the gym. There's ample parking available, which is a plus.

*Pros and Cons:*
- *Pros:* Modern equipment, friendly staff, clean facilities
- *Cons:* Can get crowded during peak hours

Overall, I had a great experience at Jenoub Fitness Ajman. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a quality gym in the area.

reviews.author: khalifa k
reviews.text:
The gym is excellent in terms of cleanliness, modern equipment, and professional staff. The overall atmosphere is very motivating for regular workouts.

However, I have one major complaint regarding the management's lack of respect for trainees' preferences when requesting music to be played. Working out without music makes the experience less enjoyable and dampens the enthusiasm. I highly recommend that management takes member feedback into consideration to create a better and more energetic workout environment

reviews.author: Mr Zain
reviews.text:
Good gym with new machines and less crowd. rates are similar to any other gym. The lower section is for regular gym, whereas the upper section is for cardio and more focused on legs. Both section has its own washroom.

Amenities:
1) Lockers ( small and mid size)
2) Shower
3) Washrooms
4) Free Parking

Benefits:
1) No other gym nearby in the vicinity
2) Less crowd
3) New Machines
4) Coaches are really helpful

reviews.author: Irfan Yoonus
reviews.text: Great gym with a positive vibe! The staff are super welcoming, and the trainers really know their stuff. The gym is always clean, the machines are modern, and there’s plenty of space so it never feels overcrowded. I’ve noticed real progress since joining, and I actually look forward to my workouts now. Totally worth it!

reviews.author: Rayees Fathima
reviews.text:
I've been training at this gym for a while now, it has a great atmosphere that keeps me motivated every time I walk in. Whether you're a beginner or more advanced, there's something here for everyone.

What truly sets this gym apart is the coaching staff. The All Four coaches (Akshaya) are very knowledgeable and professional, and also incredibly supportive and approachable. They take the time to understand your goals, tailor workouts to your needs, and push you to become the best version of yourself — all while making sure you're staying safe and using proper technique.

Every session feels structured, challenging, and rewarding. Thanks to their guidance, I've seen real progress in my strength, endurance, and overall fitness.

Highly recommend this gym to anyone looking for a supportive community and results-driven training environment. You won’t be disappointed!😊

reviews.author: Siba 473
reviews.text: I’ve been coming here for almost 2 weeks and I really like it, the coaches are friendly and helpful, and the atmosphere is great. The only thing missing is internet access. I hope they can add it soon!

reviews.author: Shamil S
reviews.text: I've been training at this gym for a few months now, and I can honestly say it's one of the best fitness environments I've experienced. The facility is clean, well-maintained, and equipped with top-notch machines and free weights. The staff is always friendly, knowledgeable, and eager to help. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete, the trainers tailor workouts to your goals and make you feel supported every step of the way. I especially appreciate the positive vibe and sense of community here—it's motivating and energizing every time I walk in. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Vajid Hassan
reviews.text: Great gym with friendly trainers, positive coaches, and a motivating atmosphere. The facilities are clean and well-equipped. Highly recommended!
